faq.q: Do I have to create an account to use it?
faq.a: No. Pantry, reminders, meals and shopping all work out of the box, and your profile stays on your device. Accounts and cloud sync are planned capabilities — they’re not in the current version.

faq.q: Does it work without a network?
faq.a: Yes. Pantry, expiry reminders, meal planning and everything you’ve saved keep working offline. Remote AI is a future optional capability; it isn’t enabled in the current version.

Recognition runs on-device with Apple Vision and counts as a suggestion. When the app isn’t sure, it asks you to check — and you can always edit the result or type the item yourself. This version doesn’t support retail barcode lookup.

faq.q: Will AI change my pantry on its own?
faq.a: No. AI only recognizes and suggests; it never changes your pantry directly. Recognition results, meal plans and shopping changes all take effect only after you confirm them.

faq.q: Can I fully trust expiry dates and nutrition info?
faq.a: No. Dates and nutrition come from your entry, packaging or recognition — they’re management references. Packaging labels, recall notices, and how food smells and looks come first.

faq.q: Will FreshLife gradually learn my family’s habits?
faq.a: That’s a long-term direction, not a feature of the current version. Today’s FreshLife has no long-term memory and does no automatic shopping. If memory or automatic-suggestion features ever ship, they’ll be off by default, explained first, used only with your consent, and kept on your device. We won’t “learn you” silently in the background.

faq.q: How do I export or delete my data?
faq.a: In the app, go to Profile → Privacy Center. You can export text data, reset AI memory, or delete all local data. Deleted local data may not be recoverable.
